criteria.other: journal bytes never exceed the reservation; every state norm and signal is finite; the eight repeated runs return bitwise identical gradients; every optimization objective and gradient norm is finite
criteria.source_of_limits: fixture-specific budgets declared from a 5000-step, 8-run, 30-update pilot on the same fixture and machine (RSS slopes 0.02 MB per 1000 steps, 0.36 MB per run with one 2.5 MB jump at the third run, 0.0006 MB per update; relative norm 2e-11 one block after the source ends and 3e-14 at step 5000): the RSS bounds are the brief's 1 MB per 1000 steps and margins of about three times and four hundred times the pilot slopes; the energy growth limit 1.5 bounds any excursion above the post-source peak without demanding monotone decay, and the last-half ceiling 1e-6 sits eight orders above the pilot's decayed level so that only an exponential late-time instability reaches it
